entities.name: Luis Marín de San Martín
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis Marín de San Martín is a Spanish Catholic prelate who has served as Prefect of the Dicastery for the Service of Charity since March 2026. He previously served as joint under-secretary for the Synod of Bishops from 2021 to 2026. He has also served as general assistant for the Order of Saint Augustine at their generalate in Rome.
